title: Never Returns Empty
story:
A farmer once sowed seeds across a wide field.

Some seeds fell on dry patches.

Some were buried deep in soil.

Days passed.

Nothing seemed to happen.

People told him,

“Maybe the seeds are wasted.”

But the farmer waited patiently.

After some time, rain came.

Slowly, green shoots began to appear.

The field that looked empty became full of life.

The farmer smiled and said,

“Nothing planted with purpose is ever wasted.”

In life, we sometimes feel like nothing is changing.

Prayers feel unanswered.

Promises feel delayed.

But God’s Word is never empty.

What He speaks will accomplish its purpose.

It will not return without fruit.

Even when we cannot see it yet.
life_lesson:
God’s Word always fulfills its purpose.

Trust it even when results are not visible.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You that Your Word never fails.

Help me to trust Your promises even when I don’t see results.

Teach me patience in waiting.

Let Your Word bear fruit in my life.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Are you waiting for answers that feel delayed?

Do you believe God’s Word is working even now?

How can you trust His timing today?
verse:
As the rain and the snow come down from heaven,
and do not return to it without watering the earth...
so is My word that goes out from My mouth.
It will not return to Me empty.
